coverage.note: No January 2026 post-Cabinet briefing was located. The first Cabinet meeting of 2026 was held on 10 February 2026. No later 2026 briefing was included because this package only contains briefings verified in the source review.

secondarySources: Zimbabwe Ministry of Information Cabinet Briefs
provenance.copyrightNote: This file contains structured metadata, short summaries, tags and source links. It does not reproduce the full text of third-party briefing documents.

briefings.title: First Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Constitutional Amendment No. 3 Bill, 2026
briefings.summary: Cabinet considered proposed constitutional reforms, alongside other government updates and preparations.
briefings.sourceNote: Veritas record for the First Cabinet Meeting of 2026.

briefings.title: Second Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Seasonal disease risks, urgent vaccine deployment and proposed contingency funding
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed seasonal disease risks, vaccine deployment needs and contingency funding in the context of elevated rainy-season public-health risks.
briefings.sourceNote: Veritas record for the Second Cabinet Meeting of 2026.

briefings.title: Third Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: National Action Plan for Children IV: 2026-2030
briefings.summary: Cabinet approved the National Action Plan for Children IV, focused on child well-being, rights and multisectoral implementation.
briefings.sourceNote: Veritas record for the Third Cabinet Meeting of 2026.

briefings.title: Fourth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: First Round Crop, Livestock and Fisheries Assessment Report
briefings.summary: Cabinet received the First Round Crop, Livestock and Fisheries Assessment, covering agricultural production and national food-security indicators.
briefings.sourceNote: The Veritas page title is misdated, but the page text states the Fourth Cabinet Meeting was held on 3 March 2026.

briefings.title: Fifth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: 2026 Winter Production Plan
briefings.summary: Cabinet approved the 2026 Winter Production Plan, including wheat, Irish potato and barley production within the national agricultural strategy.
briefings.sourceNote: Veritas record for the Fifth Cabinet Meeting of 2026.

briefings.title: Sixth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Review of licences, permits, levies and fees in agriculture
briefings.summary: Cabinet approved a review of licences, permits, levies and fees across crops, horticulture, fisheries and fertiliser subsectors to reduce the cost of doing business.
briefings.sourceNote: Veritas record for the Sixth Cabinet Meeting of 2026.

briefings.title: Seventh Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Update on tobacco production and marketing
briefings.summary: Cabinet considered an update on tobacco production and marketing.
briefings.sourceNote: Veritas record for the Seventh Cabinet Meeting of 2026.

briefings.title: Eighth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Summer 2025/2026 and Winter 2026 crops update
briefings.summary: Cabinet received an update on the 2025/2026 summer season and 2026 winter crop programme.
briefings.sourceNote: Veritas March 2026 archive contains the Eighth Cabinet Meeting record.

briefings.title: Ninth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: National Formalisation Strategy
briefings.summary: Cabinet approved the National Formalisation Strategy addressing transition from informal to formal economic activity.
briefings.sourceNote: Veritas April 2026 archive contains the Ninth Cabinet Meeting record.

briefings.title: Tenth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Minerals value chain: mining to beneficiation, industrialisation and exportation
briefings.summary: Cabinet approved a minerals value-chain framework linking mining, beneficiation, industrialisation and exports.
briefings.sourceNote: Veritas record for the Tenth Cabinet Meeting of 2026.

briefings.title: Eleventh Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Second Round Crop, Livestock and Fisheries Assessment and cotton remedial measures
briefings.summary: Cabinet considered the Second Round Crop, Livestock and Fisheries Assessment and remedial measures affecting cotton production.
briefings.sourceNote: The Veritas listing title contains a month typo, while the record text states 21 April 2026.

briefings.title: Twelfth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: 2025/2026 summer crops marketing and 2026 winter crops production plan
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed summer crop marketing and the 2026 winter crop production plan.
briefings.sourceNote: Veritas April 2026 archive contains the Twelfth Cabinet Meeting record.

briefings.title: Thirteenth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Review of licences, permits, levies and fees in the mining sector
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed mining-sector licences, permits, levies and fees as part of wider business reforms.
briefings.sourceNote: Direct Veritas PDF for the Thirteenth Cabinet Meeting.

briefings.title: Fourteenth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Summer crops marketing, winter production and agricultural impacts of El Niño
briefings.summary: Cabinet considered crop marketing, winter production and historical agricultural impacts of El Niño.
briefings.sourceNote: Veritas Decision Matrix listing for the Fourteenth Cabinet Meeting.

briefings.title: Fifteenth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Update on the National Drug and Substance Abuse Response
briefings.summary: Cabinet approved an update on the national response to drug and substance abuse.
briefings.sourceNote: Veritas record for the Fifteenth Cabinet Meeting.

briefings.title: Sixteenth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Summer crops marketing, winter production and irrigation insights
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed summer crop marketing, winter production and mechanisation and irrigation insights, noting a positive national food-security outlook.
briefings.sourceNote: Direct Veritas PDF for the Sixteenth Cabinet Meeting.

briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed summer crop marketing and the 2026 winter production plan.

briefings.title: Nineteenth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: End-of-cycle report on implementation of priority projects for the 1st 100-Day Cycle of 2026
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed implementation progress for priority projects in the first 100-Day Cycle of 2026.
briefings.sourceNote: Veritas Cabinet listing for the Nineteenth Cabinet Meeting.

briefings.title: Twentieth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Summer crops marketing and 2026 winter crops production plan
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed summer crop marketing and winter production, including grain stocks and farmer payment arrangements; it also approved the Zimbabwe Sugarcane Industry Development Plan 2026-2035.
briefings.sourceNote: The Veritas index appears to omit Meeting 20; this record is supported by the 20th post-Cabinet briefing reproduced by The Herald and contemporaneous ZBC reporting.

briefings.summary: Cabinet approved the Nutrition Financing Strategy under the Cabinet Committee on Food Security and Nutrition.
